doc.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
doc.interviewee: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum

title: George's father and Professor LeBlanc's later life
summary: George's father, also George McCullum, played cornet; they spell LeBlanc, who played alto, lived in Chicago and California and taught children.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Did he ever say anything about his father or anybody else? You mentioned his uncle, of course, maybe his father. Well, his father.

His father was a musician too, old man McCullum. He'd been a musician. He was a musician too. What was his name? George McCullum. Another George. Yes, he was a George McCullum. Yes, he was a George McCullum. Yes. His father was a musician too. But now I can't tell you that much about him. Yeah, that's for sure I know. I had a four-hour instrument. But I knew he always said, the old man always said, come on, he was there. He played the carnette too. But I really know about my uncle teaching George and him. Yes. They had this young man, him and Kenshin. And I can't think of Kenshin's first name. I don't remember I ever heard of it either. Yeah, Kenshin. He and Kenshin started those young boys off. And what you call him? Maxine's daddy. He was in there too. The Holdtree. The Holdtree. The Holdtree. The Holdtree was in there. The Cheap was in there. Mr. Fett's brother. Mr. Fett's brother. Yeah. What Holdtree was he with? I don't know. James Holdtree. I don't know. James Holdtree. All them youngsters. My uncle had. He started out the boys. You know, he didn't play long. Teaching them. Teaching them. Uncle was teaching. Him and Kenshin started this band. And I remember that first name.
Did you get Uncle's name? Professor Tom LeBlanc. Yes.
How do you spell him LeBlanc for sure?

That's the way I think it's in the picture with the Allen band. He played, I think it was the say alto or was his instrument? Yeah. Alto was his instrument. He was in that band, the picture with Henry Allen Senior's band over in Al Jair. That's right. When did he go to California?

He's been up there for years in California. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. He lived in Chicago. And then he went to California. He's married a second time since the third. His first wife died here. And he's married a second time since he married a second wife and the third wife.
Did he only play in the brass bands?
And he taught children with the children.
I mean did he ever play in the dance band or the string band? No, not that I know.
I don't know. He had some kind of a concert band out there. He taught children.
With his instrument, the alto, they wouldn't use that ordinary dance band.
But he did well teaching since I've been out of college. He used to teach.
